{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders (status == 'completed')
df_filtered = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check number of rows after filtering
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_filtered)}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_orders_filtered = df_filtered[df_filtered['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders after filtering: {len(qa_orders_filtered)}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate:.6f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate:.6f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.6f}")"}
